cards.example_en: In the story the hero spares his enemy and ends the war.
cards.example_zh: 故事里，英雄放过敌人，战争就此结束。

cards.example_en: The dancers stayed energetic until the end.
cards.example_zh: 舞者们一直精力充沛直到结束。

cards.example_en: The battery holds enough energy to run the lamp for three hours.
cards.example_zh: 这块电池的能量足够让灯亮三个小时。

cards.example_en: Her father is an engineer.
cards.example_zh: 她父亲是工程师。

cards.example_en: I practise English by reading the canteen menu aloud each day.
cards.example_zh: 我每天朗读食堂菜单来练习英语。

cards.example_en: We enjoy hot soup on cold winter evenings.
cards.example_zh: 寒冷的冬夜，我们喜欢喝热汤。

cards.example_en: We don't have enough time for another game.
cards.example_zh: 我们没有足够的时间进行另一场比赛。

cards.example_en: Enter the museum through the wide main gate.
cards.example_zh: 从宽阔的正门进入博物馆。

cards.example_en: We should protect the environment.
cards.example_zh: 我们应该保护环境。

cards.example_en: The museum has a room of toys from the era of black-and-white films.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆有一间展室，陈列黑白电影时代的玩具。

cards.example_en: May I borrow your eraser?
cards.example_zh: 我能借一下你的橡皮吗？

cards.example_en: I like fruit, especially apples.
cards.example_zh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。

cards.example_en: Even little kids can learn this song.
cards.example_zh: 连小孩子也能学会这首歌。

cards.example_en: In the evening the streetlights come on before we reach the bridge.
cards.example_zh: 晚上，我们还没走到桥，路灯就亮了。

cards.example_en: The blackout was the top event on the local evening news.
cards.example_zh: 停电是当地晚间新闻的头条事件。

cards.example_en: Have you ever visited Beijing?
cards.example_zh: 你曾经去过北京吗？

cards.example_en: Every morning I drink a glass of water.
cards.example_zh: 我每天早上喝一杯水。

cards.example_en: Everybody enjoyed the class party.
cards.example_zh: 每个人都很喜欢这次班级聚会。

cards.example_en: Everyone must bring a pencil tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 每个人明天都必须带一支铅笔。

cards.example_en: Everyday shoes are fine for the walk, so leave the heavy boots.
cards.example_zh: 这次走路穿日常的鞋就行，把沉重的靴子留下。

cards.example_en: Everything on the table is ready.
cards.example_zh: 桌上的一切都准备好了。

cards.example_en: There are flowers everywhere in the park.
cards.example_zh: 公园里到处都是花。

cards.example_en: Your answer is exactly right.
cards.example_zh: 你的答案完全正确。

cards.example_en: I have a maths exam tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 我明天有数学考试。

cards.example_en: Maya's rainfall graph became an example that the rest of the class copied.
cards.example_zh: 玛娅的降雨统计图成了班上其他人仿照的例子。

cards.example_en: Her excellent drawing hung in the school corridor all month.
cards.example_zh: 她的优秀画作在学校走廊里挂了整整一个月。

cards.example_en: Everyone came except Tom.
cards.example_zh: 除了汤姆，大家都来了。

cards.example_en: The pupils were excited about visiting the zoo on Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 学生们对周四去动物园感到兴奋。

cards.example_en: The football match was really exciting.
cards.example_zh: 足球比赛真的很精彩。

cards.example_en: A headache is a weak excuse for skipping the group presentation.
cards.example_zh: 头疼算不上逃避小组展示的好借口。

cards.example_en: Five minutes of exercise in the yard wakes me up more than coffee does.
cards.example_zh: 在院子里锻炼五分钟，比喝咖啡更能让我清醒。

cards.example_en: I expect a letter from my uncle this week.
cards.example_zh: 我期待这周能收到叔叔的信。

cards.example_en: That restaurant is too expensive for us.
cards.example_zh: 那家餐厅对我们来说太贵了。

cards.example_en: Camping in the rain was a miserable experience, but we still laugh about it.
cards.example_zh: 雨中露营是一次很糟的经历，可我们现在说起来还是会笑。

cards.example_en: She is an expert on local history.
cards.example_zh: 她是本地历史方面的专家。

cards.example_en: Can you explain this maths problem to me?
cards.example_zh: 你能把这道数学题解释给我听吗？

cards.example_en: We want to explore the old town this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我们想这个周末探索老城区。

cards.example_en: Short poems help students express feelings about home.
cards.example_zh: 短诗能帮助学生表达对家的感情。

cards.example_en: Soap in my eye sent me running to the bathroom tap.
cards.example_zh: 肥皂进了眼睛，我跑去卫生间的水龙头边冲洗。

cards.example_en: Young athletes face strong rivals in the city final.
cards.example_zh: 年轻选手要在全市决赛中面对强大的对手。

cards.example_en: It is a fact that sound travels faster through water than through air.
cards.example_zh: 声音在水里比在空气里传得更快，这是事实。

cards.example_en: The shoe factory by the river hires students for two weeks each summer.
cards.example_zh: 河边那家鞋厂每年夏天雇学生干两个星期。

cards.example_en: You may fail the quiz if several answers stay blank.
cards.example_zh: 如果好几道题空着，你这次小测可能会不及格。

cards.example_en: The judge gave a fair score to every dancer on the stage.
cards.example_zh: 评委给舞台上的每一位舞者都打了公平的分数。

cards.example_en: Ripe apples fall from the old tree in autumn.
cards.example_zh: 秋天，熟了的苹果会从那棵老树上掉下来。

cards.example_en: A false fire alarm emptied the canteen during lunch.
cards.example_zh: 一次假火警让食堂在午饭时被清空了。

cards.example_en: His face looks familiar.
cards.example_zh: 他的脸看起来很眼熟。

cards.example_en: Our family makes dumplings together whenever grandparents visit.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷奶奶一来，我们全家就一起包饺子。

cards.example_en: The famous swimmer visited our pool and signed our shirts.
cards.example_zh: 那位著名的游泳运动员来到我们的泳池，并在我们的衬衫上签名。

cards.example_en: A desk fan kept the exam room bearable during the heatwave.
cards.example_zh: 热浪那几天，书桌上的风扇让考场还能待得住。

word.example_en: The road is long. Even so, we continue.
word.example_zh: 路还很长。即便如此，我们继续。

word.example_en: The room is quiet except for a clock.
word.example_zh: 房间很安静，除了一只钟以外。

word.example_en: The class is excited about the science fair.
word.example_zh: 全班为科学展感到兴奋。

word.example_en: We take exercise on the playground.
word.example_zh: 我们在操场上锻炼身体。

word.example_en: Please keep an eye on the oven.
We must face up to the calculation error.
word.example_zh: 我们必须正视这个计算错误。

word.example_en: She stayed calm in the face of questions.
word.example_zh: 面对着提问，她保持冷静。

word.example_en: As a matter of fact, I was in the lab.
word.example_zh: 事实上，我当时在实验室。

word.example_en: This tune is familiar to most students.
word.example_zh: 这段曲子为大多数学生所熟悉。

word.example_en: Are you familiar with this song?
Hangzhou is famous for its lake.
